name: Itabashi
tagline: Shinjuku in 11 minutes and Shibuya in 16 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Itabashi City, served by JR Saikyo Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 26 minutes to Otemachi, 11 minutes to Shinjuku, 16 minutes to Shibuya and 41 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 26.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 6.5 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 26.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 22.3 m to 28.8 m, a difference of 6.5 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 5 clinics and 9 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 愛誠病院, about 15 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 小川医院, about 19 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: JR Saikyo Line.
congestion: JR Saikyo Line runs at 167% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 板橋→池袋, which includes this station. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Shin-Itabashi, but Itabashi is ahead on how easy the shopping is and quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi 6 minutes sooner than Itabashi. One-room rents run about ¥10,000 lower.

neighbours.lead: rent, commuting and the flood projection are all much the same.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Itabashi.

noiseSources: The 首都高速中央環状線 viaduct runs a short walk from the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 12 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the JR Saikyo Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are some of the most heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
